''L. pyrenaicus'' subsp. ''pyrenaicus'' | synonyms = ''Scorzoneroides pyrenaica''{{citation | author = Greuter, W. | author2 = Gutermann, W. | author3 = Talavera, S. | name-list-style = amp | title = A preliminary conspectus of Scorzoneroides (Compositae, Cichorieae) with validation of the required new names | journal = Willdenowia | year = 2006 | volume = 36 | issue = 2 | pages = 689–692 | issn = 0511-9618 | doi = 10.3372/wi.36.36204 | s2cid = 85657923 }} }} '''''Leontodon pyrenaicus''''' is a species of [[hawkbit]] found in the [[Alps]], [[Pyrenees]], [[Cantabrian Mountains]], northern [[Apennine Mountains|Apennines]] and northern parts of the [[Balkans|Balkan Peninsula]]. It grows in [[meadow]]s and on stony slopes from the [[tree line]] to over 3000 m, usually on [[acid]]ic soils. It is [[perennial plant|perennial]], and flowers from June to August. The stems of ''L. pyrenaicus'' are narrow, up to 30 cm long, with several scale-like leaves, and with a single [[inflorescence|flower head]] at the top. The leaves form a basal [[rosette (botany)|rosette]], and are clearly stalked. The flower heads are 20–20 mm wide and bright yellow. ''L. pyrenaicus'' is divided into three [[allopatric]] [[subspecies]] which differ in their size and in the nature of the hairs on the [[bract]]s: *''L. pyrenaicus'' subsp. ''cantabricus'' lives in the Cantabrian Mountains *''L. pyrenaicus'' subsp. ''helveticus'' lives in the Alps, Apennines and Balkans *''L. pyrenaicus'' subsp. ''pyrenaicus'' lives in the Pyrenees A number of authors since 2006, based on molecular evidence, have divided the genus ''[[Leontodon]]'' into two, with the former [[subgenus]] ''Oporinia'' split out into the genus ''Scorzoneroides''. If this is done, ''L. pyrenaicus'' is placed in ''Scorzoneroides'' as ''S. pyrenaica''. It is also common for the subspecies to be considered separate species, in which case they are called ''Leontodon cantabricus'' (or ''Scorzoneroides cantabrica''), ''L. helveticus'' (''S. helvetica'') and ''L. pyrenaicus'' (''S. pyrenaica''). ==References== {{Reflist}} *Fischer, M.
